name: cmux
title_zh: 多窗格布局里，指哪打哪的确定性导航员
tagline_zh: 自动化脚本在 cmux 里迷路？它让每个窗格、工作区、面板都有精确坐标，移动、聚焦、重排全按你的剧本走。
tagline_en: Tired of scripts lost in cmux? Get exact placement & routing for panes, workspaces, surfaces—move, focus.
desc_en: End-user control of cmux topology and routing (windows, workspaces, panes/surfaces, focus, moves, reorder, identify, trigger flash). Use when automation needs deterministic placement and navigation in a multi-pane cmux layout.
why_zh: 把拓扑当状态机管，每次操作前先确认当前布局，绝不靠猜。自动化要的是可复现，它给的是确定性的每一步。
why_en: Treats topology as a state machine, verifying layout before every move. Automation needs reproducibility—this delivers.
limit_zh: 只认 cmux 自己的窗格体系，不接管 tmux 或终端原生命令；需要目标环境已运行 cmux 且暴露控制接口。
limit_en: Only manages cmux-native panes/workspaces; requires a running cmux with control interface exposed. Won't touch tmux or raw terminal commands.
